product_overview: EmoVest is a web platform for trading journaling that helps users record accounts and operations, then review performance through monthly, emotional, and calendar-based analytics. It combines manual trading logs with local AI-based emotional analysis to show how mindset relates to results.
core_goals: Create an account and sign in to access the platform
Register and manage one or more trading accounts
Record, edit, and delete trading operations within a selected account
Review performance statistics by account, month, and year
Inspect emotional analysis linked to trading activity
View daily profit and loss in a calendar format
Recover access to an account through password reset

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allow visitors to register, sign in, and recover access to their account using email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in name, email, and password details -> Select an account plan -> Accept the terms and conditions -> Submit the registration form -> See confirmation and continue to /login
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Optionally enable email remembrance -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard after successful authentication
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter email -> Request a password reset link -> See a success message
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter a new password and confirmation -> Submit the reset form -> See redirect to /login after successful reset

features.name: Trading Account Management
features.description: Let authenticated users view, create, update, delete, and adjust funds for their trading accounts.
user_flows: Navigate to /perfil -> View the list of trading accounts -> Create a new account with name, broker, funds, and currency -> Save the account -> See the new account in the list
Navigate to /perfil -> View the list of trading accounts -> Choose an existing account to edit -> Update its details -> Save changes -> See the updated account information
Navigate to /perfil -> View the list of trading accounts -> Choose an account to delete -> Confirm the deletion -> See the account removed from the list
Navigate to /perfil -> View the list of trading accounts -> Open the funds adjustment flow for an account -> Deposit or withdraw funds -> Confirm the adjustment -> See the updated balance

features.name: Trading Operations Management
features.description: Enable users to manage buy and sell operations for a selected trading account.
user_flows: Navigate to /trading -> Select a trading account -> View the current operations list -> Add a new operation with instrument, type, size, prices, emotion, and notes -> Save the operation -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /trading -> Select a trading account -> View the operations list -> Choose an existing operation to edit -> Update its details -> Save changes -> See the updated operation
Navigate to /trading -> Select a trading account -> View the operations list -> Choose an operation to delete -> Confirm the deletion -> See the operation removed from the list

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Show monthly trading performance metrics for a selected account, including charts and key performance indicators.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Select a trading account -> Select a month and year -> View updated performance metrics and charts
Navigate to /dashboard -> Select a different trading account -> Change the month or year selection -> Observe the dashboard refresh with the new account and period data

features.name: Emotional Statistics
features.description: Display emotional-context analytics for a selected account and time period using charts.
user_flows: Navigate to /estadisticas -> Select a trading account, year, and month -> View emotional distribution charts and profit-related breakdowns
Navigate to /estadisticas -> Change the selected account or period -> Observe the emotional statistics update to match the new selection

features.name: Calendar PnL View
features.description: Provide a calendar view of daily profit and loss for a selected account.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> Select a trading account -> View the calendar populated with daily PnL values
Navigate to /calendar -> Move between months in the calendar header -> Observe the daily PnL entries update for the new period
Navigate to /calendar -> Select or hover a day -> View the detailed PnL information for that date

features.name: Application Navigation
features.description: Provide access to the main public and authenticated sections through the header, navbar, and sidebar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the brand logo -> Return to the landing page
Navigate through the main navigation links -> Open the login, signup, dashboard, trading, profile, statistics, or calendar sections
When signed in, open the user menu -> Choose the logout action -> Return to the unauthenticated state

tech_stack: SessionStorage for JWT tokens, LocalStorage for "remember email" and userName

routes.description: Landing page with marketing hero and Footer
User login (email + password) with "Remember me" and link to /forgot-password
User registration form (name, email, password, account type free/premium, terms checkbox)
Submit new password using token from reset email
Main dashboard with trading-account selector, monthly stats and account creation
Same Dashboard component rendered under the operaciones sub-route
CRUD of trading operations within a selected account
User profile, list/manage trading accounts (create, edit, delete, adjust funds)
Emotional-context statistics by year/month for a selected account
Calendar view of daily PnL using FullCalendar

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with email and password, store JWT in sessionStorage, fetch /me to cache userName
user_interactions: Optionally toggle "Recordarme" to persist email in localStorage
On failure see error message under the form

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account with name, email, password and plan selection (free/premium); requires accepting T&C
user_interactions: Fill name, email, password, confirm password
On validation error see inline error message

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Use email token to set a new password
user_interactions: Token is read from URL query string

features.name: Trading Accounts CRUD
features.description: View, create, update, delete trading accounts and adjust account funds
user_interactions: Click "Nueva cuenta" and fill form (name, broker, funds, currency)
Adjust funds via a modal (deposit / withdraw)

features.name: Trading Operations CRUD
features.description: Manage operations (buy/sell entries) under a selected trading account
user_interactions: Select an account from the dropdown
Add a new operation via form (instrument, type, lots, prices, emotion, etc.)

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Show monthly aggregated stats (PnL, win rate, etc.) for a selected account and month/year
user_interactions: Select month and year via custom selects
View charts and KPIs that refresh on selection change

features.name: Emotional Statistics
features.description: View statistics broken down by emotional context for a given month/year
user_interactions: View bar/pie/line charts (Recharts) of emotions vs PnL

features.name: Calendar View
features.description: Calendar grid of daily PnL for a selected account using FullCalendar
user_interactions: Navigate month/year in the calendar header
Hover/click days to see PnL detail

features.name: Navigation and Header
features.description: Top header with brand, navigation links and authentication-aware links
user_interactions: Click brand logo to go to /
Click navigation links (Login, Signup, Dashboard, Trading, Perfil, Estadisticas, Calendar)
Logout from user menu when authenticated

known_limitations.issue: Token is stored in sessionStorage and cleared on tab close; "Recordarme" only persists email, not session
known_limitations.impact: Users must re-authenticate after closing the tab even with "Recordarme" enabled

known_limitations.issue: API base URL is hardcoded to http://localhost:8000 in multiple components
known_limitations.location: src/components/Login.jsx, Signup.jsx, ForgotPassword.jsx, ResetPassword.jsx, Dashboard.jsx, OperacionesTrading.jsx, PerfilUsuario.jsx, EstadisticasEmocionales.jsx, calendar.jsx, src/utils/userSession.js
known_limitations.impact: Frontend cannot easily target a different backend without code changes (no env-variable config)

known_limitations.issue: No client-side route guard — authenticated routes are reachable without a token; protection relies on backend 401 only
known_limitations.impact: Authenticated pages mount and call APIs before redirecting, which can produce flashes of empty UI and unnecessary failed requests

known_limitations.issue: Mixed use of fetch and axios across components
known_limitations.impact: Inconsistent error handling and headers; harder to add interceptors (e.g., automatic JWT refresh)
